title: Saronic header
description: A 64px sticky header with a bold wordmark left and mono capital links plus a two-line menu button right. Over a dark hero it is transparent with light text; once the hero has scrolled away it turns into a pale bar with ink text, a hairline under it and one down its centre (0.3s). The menu opens a dark panel of destinations with one-line descriptions.
notes: `overlay` is for pages that open on a dark full-bleed hero: it pulls the hero up under the bar (-mb-16) and stays transparent until the window height minus solidOffset has scrolled
without `overlay` it is the solid pale bar from the start
needs JavaScript for the scroll switch and the menu
name: saronic-header

props.name: brand
props.description: the company name, set as a bold wordmark

props.name: mark
props.description: a small mark before the name (an icon)

props.name: links
props.description: mono links before the menu button (desktop only), split by a thin bar

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: the menu button's text while open

props.name: overlay
props.description: sit transparent over a dark hero (light text) until it has scrolled away, then turn solid

props.name: hideBrandOverHero
props.description: with overlay: hide the wordmark on desktop while over the hero (the hero shows a giant one)

props.name: solidOffset
props.description: with overlay: turn solid once the page has scrolled the window height minus this many px
